mapper.insert: INSERT INTO domainforge_inbox (consumer_group, event_id) VALUES (#{group}, #{eventId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM domainforge_inbox WHERE (consumer_group, event_id) IN ( SELECT consumer_group, event_id FROM domainforge_inbox WHERE received_at < now() - make_interval(hours => #{retentionHours}) LIMIT #{limit})
